meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 接入Slack后，Claude就能在频道或私信中收发消息。此技能会复制并注册Slack适配器、安装依赖、运行测试，然后引导你选Socket或webhook并填凭据，重启即生效。
howto.when: 当你说要接入Slack、添加Slack频道，或让Claude接入Slack时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 添加进来，作为聊天渠道。
say.note: 开始复制、注册并安装 Slack 适配器。

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接入 Slack。
say.note: 选择无需公网地址的 Socket 模式。

say.text: Slack 事件改用 Webhook 接收。
say.note: 切换到 Webhook，需要公网 HTTPS 地址。

howto.what_en: Connects Claude to Slack for chatting in channels or DMs. Copies/registers the Slack adapter, installs a pinned dependency, runs build/test, then asks you to choose Socket Mode or webhook, enter credentials, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Slack as a chat channel or integrate Claude with Slack.

say_en.text: Add Slack as a chat channel for Claude.

say_en.note: Uses Socket Mode, no public URL.

say_en.text: Switch Slack event delivery to Webhook.
say_en.note: Needs a public HTTPS URL for receiving.
